newsitem.title: GREECE: ALPHA CREDIT BANK CUTS PRIME RATE TO 16.75PCT.
newsitem.headline: ALPHA CREDIT BANK CUTS PRIME RATE TO 16.75PCT.

text.p: Greece's Alpha Credit Bank cut its prime rate for working capital and fixed asset loans by 50 basis points to 16.75 percent from 17.25 previously, it said in a statement.
Alpha Credit, which reviews its rates weekly, said the maximum add-on would remain unchanged at 3.5 percent.

Its adjustable-rate mortgages were set lower at 17.00 percent from 17.50 percent previously. The bank launched 15-year mortgages in October 1995 with rates set at 12.0 percent for the first five years. Rates on these loans now drop to 11.75 percent. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
